items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Zeke was in there, now all those boys, you see, you had to watch Washington during that time... Harry White -- I mean White Brothers played for the Smart Set.

ctx.x: of business, then at the end of the season they all quit doing, they'd all come out on the field and march and then one who won, he challenged the boys in gray and oh, my goodness, one guy had orders, so he was running up to the band all of a sudden, then he ran and did something in that arms and them spread all out and he won the cup, won it every year, so people get imagination, so now coming back to this music, that was a band.

Now, the White Brothers they were a society band. Zeke ? was playing in that band, Harry White and there were four brothers, Harold White, Edward White, Sparky White, about four, and Zeke was in there, now all those boys, you see, you had to watch Washington during that time. Washington had what they called "high yellow" people and see, that society now, these people had all them good big jobs, man, and they owned all their homes and they was up there, so when these other people -- well, anyway, Harry White -- I…

And when the White Brothers couldn't play for the smart set, well, the Bluebirds would come in and I joined the Bluebirds, and we played that pretty music too, and everybody was up there, looking pretty and and then everybody was kind of halfway yellow in there, see, but the thing when they're getting them dances, they'd have something over the door, I imagine there was something over that door, and if you didn't fit that thing, you wasn't getting in there.
